name: sticky
need: Keep a head, a foot or a side in view while its list scrolls, raised once content passes under it

--ds-sticky-offset.description: the distance of a `.ds-sticky` box from its scroller's edge (a top bar's height above a scrolling page)

--ds-sticky-bg.description: the opaque fill of a `.ds-sticky` box (`--side`: none)

--ds-sticky-line.description: the hairline of the raised edge of a `.ds-sticky` box

--ds-sticky-shadow.description: the shadow of the raised edge of a `.ds-sticky` box
